scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:docs
scripts.check: tsc -b && npm test && npm run theme:audit
scripts.test: node --test tests/apiContract.test.mjs tests/apiRequests.test.mjs tests/relationImport.test.mjs tests/inFlightReads.test.mjs tests/sourceConfiguration.test.mjs tests/permissionSelection.test.mjs tests/runtimeMigrationStatus.test.mjs tests/runtimeDataSourceStatus.test.mjs tests/detailTabs.test.mjs tests/sdkBoundary.test.mjs tests/updatePipeline.test.mjs tests/runTimeline.test.mjs tests/ulm.test.mjs tests/sourceQuery.test.mjs tests/timescalePolicies.test.mjs
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/check-docs-toolchain.mjs && npm run docs:sync -- --check && node scripts/validate-docs.mjs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:sync && docusaurus start documentation --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3011 --no-open
scripts.build:docs: npm run docs:sync && npm run docs:check && docusaurus build documentation --out-dir ../dist/docs
